row.evidence: FreeWheel publishes no pricing (contact form only) and its documentation hub says "Some users may need to log in to access provisioned materials"; public hub pages mention customer SSO integrations but no SCIM.
row.notes: Quote-only enterprise ad platform (Comcast Advertising): no public plans. Public FreeWheel Hub pages show customer SSO is supported ("Continued support for existing single sign-on (SSO) integrations"), with Comcast ID Broker (Okta) as the default login, and new Curation Hub users created in an External User Management tab. A Confluence search of the public hub for "SCIM" returned 0 results, but much of the documentation and the API docs require a login, so status stays unknown.

okta.notes: No customer-facing OIN app; FreeWheel itself runs Comcast ID Broker on Okta for its own default login (c6).

entra.notes: No FreeWheel entry in the Microsoft Entra saas-apps tutorial index (toc.json) on 2026-10-05; absence cannot be quoted.

jumpcloud.notes: Not in the JumpCloud SSO & SCIM applications list (navigation of jumpcloud.com/support/integrate-with-fortinet), but absence cannot be quoted.

fallbacks.notes: Users are created by admins in the External User Management tab; hub content is partly login-gated.
